title: Audit Organization workspace — baseline, gaps, and questions
goal: Audit the Organization area to gather a baseline understanding: what exists today, what the area is trying to build, and what is missing/incomplete/needs improvement. Use deep research and sequential thinking; finish with prioritized questions for the owner to answer on how to build or fix each gap. Focus: organization identity, membership, tours, collaboration, and tenant context

in: docs/engineering/agents/organization/ — charter, state, architecture, backlog, interfaces, decisions, verification, working set
The organization default paths declared in WORKING_SET.json
docs/engineering/generated/ — routes, api-routes, components, database-schema, permissions, integrations maps
docs/work-packets/ — existing bounded work packets for this area
.agents/ legacy specialist ledgers that document this area
out: Production code and migration changes (this is a read-only audit)
docs/admin-audit remediation stream unless findings directly affect this domain
Agent registry, task model, and opencode agent definitions

acceptance_criteria: Baseline produced as docs/engineering/agents/organization/BASELINE.md: what the organization area contains today (routes, components, services, API routes, database objects, tests, evidence), each claim backed by a real path reference; plus the area's intended direction, cited to docs/DEVELOPMENT_BACKLOG.md, docs/work-packets/, docs/engineering/agents/organization/BACKLOG.md, and relevant specs.
Started from the domain working set and a packet built via npm run agents:context -- --task ORG-001; expanded scope only on evidence, with the path and reason recorded in a checkpoint.

Used deep research and sequential thinking to identify everything that is missing, incomplete, or needs improvement; recorded as docs/engineering/agents/organization/GAPS.md, every item triaged (missing / incomplete / improve) with evidence and location.

Produced docs/engineering/agents/organization/QUESTIONS.md: a prioritized list of questions to the product owner explaining how to build or fix each gap (build vs fix vs drop and sequencing); the questions are also surfaced in the final checkpoint summary.
Updated docs/engineering/agents/organization/STATE.md (working / partial / broken / focus) and BACKLOG.md to reflect the baseline findings.
No production code or migration files changed; this is a read-only audit task (qa/release additionally honor their edit: deny permission).
npm run agents:validate passes with 0 errors before completion.
The task is not blocked on unanswered questions; owner answers become follow-up task records owned by this agent.

evidence: agents:validate 2026-09-09: 17 agents, 21 tasks validated, 0 errors, 8 pre-existing SHA warnings (WARN project-map/routes/api-routes/components/database-schema/database-objects/permissions/integrations from different SHA)

progress.summary: Org workspace audit done: produced BASELINE.md, GAPS.md (15 gaps triaged missing/incomplete/improve), QUESTIONS.md; updated STATE.md and BACKLOG.md. Top 5 owner questions: (1) canonical identity model (organizations vs organizer_accounts ops_org_id bridge) - build/fix/drop; (2) membership lifecycle ownership (org domain vs admin RBAC) + finish WS-0.2 atomic accept RPC + revocation; (3) legacy /api/tours GET/POST retirement (WS-2.3) after confirming zero live clients; (4) fix acting-context headers on org hub panels (wrong-org risk); (5) public DTO manage-check parity for tour collaborators. Key gaps: lib/organization/** phantom path; org invite accept non-atomic + plaintext token (WS-0.2); admin org panels GET-only; withOrgCommand (SEC-103) only 5 call sites; tours RLS stacked generations need reconciliation (WS-1.1). No production code or migration changed (read-only audit).
